name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd - 544118 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 credit cost fell to 0.47% with slippages at INR334 crores and SMA at 3.66%; management guides FY27 gross loans +19-21%, deposits +23-25%, PAT +80%+ but no credit cost guidance beyond "same range or slightly better".

triggers.label: Slippages INR334 crores, lowest since 2020
triggers.quote: So the slippages, roughly about INR334 crores are the lowest since the first quarter of 2020
triggers.highlight: lowest since the first quarter of 2020

triggers.label: Net credit cost 0.79% → 0.47%
triggers.quote: Our net credit cost, which was 0.79% for the quarter is down to 0.47%.

triggers.label: Deposits +23%, cost of funds 8.03% → 7.46%
triggers.quote: Cost of funds down to 7.46%. We began with 8.03% in quarter 4 FY25.

triggers.label: FY27 PAT growth 80%+
triggers.quote: PAT year-on-year should grow at 80% plus
triggers.highlight: PAT year-on-year should grow at 80% plus

triggers.label: CASA lost ~8% QoQ on government deposit exit
triggers.quote: some of the government CASA went away too short of time to recover

guidance.quote: gross loan portfolio growth of 19% to 21%, deposit growth of 23% to 25% and PAT year-on-year should grow at 80% plus
So I think we should expect around 27% to 30% growth this year in CASA.

guidance.value: same range or slightly better than 0.47%
guidance.quote: I would probably urge you to view that we'll be in the same range or slightly better at best.

guidance.value: Q1 FY27 lowest point, then flat

guidance.quote: We will make every attempt to do it.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We said we 'll do PAT at INR140 crores to INR160 crores. We have come at INR140 crores.
Our net credit cost is at INR156 crores.
SMA, we said we'll come below 4%, and we are at 3.66%.

red_flags.label: Middle East war spillover on MSME
red_flags.quote: We're very watchful on MSME on what happens with any spill over effects of the Mid dle East war.

red_flags.label: Universal bank reapplication timing uncertain
red_flags.quote: So yes, now that our resul ts are out, we would get back to working on resubmitting the application.

evasions.quote: we are not giving specific guidance on credit cost for next year
So yes, now that our resul ts are out, we would get back to working on resubmitting the application.
